user_query: trass gmail with term avask from within last 2 months
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.sender_email,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet,
u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.content_type = 'gmail'
AND (
  g.subject LIKE '%avask%'
  OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%avask%'
  OR g.message_content LIKE '%avask%'
  OR g.sender_email LIKE '%avask%'
  OR g.sender_name LIKE '%avask%'
  OR g.recipient_emails LIKE '%avask%'
)
AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-2 months')
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1000
